items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: A friend of mine named LeRoy White... we got the three of us together and we got made a little band... I found this boy, Leroy White... I got him... to come up from there to play with the Virginia Ravens.

ctx.x: Did you read any music at this time?

No, no. Well, I read from the -- I knew notes because I had studied piano. But I didn't apply it to saxophone. So Merle, we got together and we got a little group together. A friend of mine named LeRoy White used to come, his parents knew my parents, they lived in

Perry, Iowa. He used to come down and he was a trumpet player. And we got the three of us together and we got made a little band. And then we added another little drummer named Melvin Saunders and we had a four piece band which we called the Jim Gem Town Ramblers (PHONETIC). We started playing around together, and playing at school parties, and playing at kids' parties and everything.
